question: Sanctuary’s function has been lost, but is it alright to think that the system for generating Lewes-sans was separate? Also, were the Lewes-sans with no personality produced in shifts? Or have they gone out of production?
answer: Omega ran off with the crystal used for clones, so the system has been lost. Hence, the Lewes-sans current numbers are all of them. There won’t be any more Lewes-sans with no personality.
